presentation.description:
Create your own custom title screen of your favorite location in-game, and open the game right up to that spot every time.
Includes a number of preinstalled title screens for you to use or get inspiration from, and an easy to use importer to
use title screens that others have shared!
presentation.summary: Create, share, and shuffle custom title screens for FFXIV.

Dalamud plugin for changing the title screen and lobby. [![Download count](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fvz32sgcoal.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com%2FTitleEdit)](https://github.com/lmcintyre/TitleEditPlugin)
[![Build status](https://github.com/lmcintyre/TitleEditPlugin/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/lmcintyre/TitleEditPlugin)
[![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/lmcintyre/TitleEditPlugin)](https://github.com/lmcintyre/TitleEditPlugin)

# Title Edit
A plugin allowing for modification of the in-game title screen, as well as custom title screens that you can create yourself. Please see the plugin installer in-game for more information.

variant.author: attick, perchbird & Speedas
variant.changelog:
- Fix the game hanging on load (hopefully)
- Improved BGM sheet loading logic
variant.description:
Create your own custom title or character select screen of your favorite location in-game, and open the game right up to that spot every time.
Includes a number of preinstalled title and character select screen presets for you to use or get inspiration from, and an easy to use importer to use presets that others have shared!
Character select presets support recording your last visited location, per character display setting and even displaying yourself on a mount.
